response.evidence_date: Original event occurred_at; phase-change occurrence date when the writer supplied no earlier evidence date.
response.undo: revert-deal-field with exact event_id; latest-field guard and idempotency key apply.

closed_deals.membership: Recorded won outcome, or no outcome with a recorded close/invoice date. Lost and paused outcomes are excluded; same workspace and account scope.
closed_deals.order: Close date descending, missing dates last, then name and id.

lost_deals.membership: Recorded lost outcome, independent of phase. Same workspace and account scope.

prospect_engagement_status.presentation: Only active prospects appear on the deal board. Inactive prospects return to the existing Leads pipeline.

phase_started_on.shape: object keyed by phase slug; YYYY-MM-DD values
phase_started_on.source: First event occurred_at per phase, in America/Chicago. A revisit does not replace the first start. Missing evidence has no key.

vendors.shape: Array of explicit active deal-vendor assignments; empty array when none. No assignments inferred from introductions or deal participants.
vendors.role: Specific service-role slug, displayed with underscores replaced by spaces.
vendors.order: Role, company name, contact name, vendor party id.

response.short_name: Record-layer short deal name; fall back to the actual deal name when contact or market evidence is absent.

open_actions.membership: Up to three open unstructured actions.
open_actions.order: Due date ascending, missing dates last, then id.

last_step.source: Newest recorded activity or completed action, ordered by occurred_at descending then id descending. Never inferred from last_touch.
